units.known_address_notes: Identity confirmed: DB Cherry (fiat/crypto wallet, ERC-4337 SmartWallet with validateUserOp and paymaster flows), Hashlock May-2025 audit. PDF supports ETH/MATIC/USDT/USDC across standards (suggests Ethereum + Polygon) but names no chain id and no address. dbcherry.com no longer resolves (000), no repo/address book found. EntryPoint used by such wallets (0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032) is a canonical singleton, not project code, so no address asserted -> PARTIAL.

Identity resolved from the Sherlock contest repo README Q&A: 'Lend-V2' cross-chain lending (Compound-V2 fork + LayerZero CoreRouter/CrossChainRouter). Deployment chains stated in README: Base, Ethereum, Sonic, Monad, BNB. Repo contains only Lend-V2 source + README, no deployments/broadcast/address book; contest page (908) lists no addresses; lend.finance resolves to an unrelated CeFi lending-desk aggregator, not this protocol. No live instance identified -> PARTIAL.
